hero.headline: One platform. Every department in sync.
hero.subheadline: Drixal ERP is an AI-ready enterprise workspace that connects people, projects, documents, sales, finance, and operations in one place — bilingual and role-based.

productBlurb: Drixal ERP unifies administration, HR, CRM, product catalogue, document control, procurement, project delivery, finance, service requests, and risk — with optional hospital, education, and fleet packs. Employees work from a shared dashboard with inbox, tasks, timesheet, and self-service requests, while each service ships its own analytics so leaders see pipeline, workforce, compliance, and project performance without switching systems.
